verdict.rationale: Segment's docs show server-side track calls (analytics.track) and a Spec/API framework for all libraries, plus a separate Public API with documented authentication (API tokens) — but that Public API is for workspace management, not event ingestion. There is no evidence pack citation of a raw HTTP Tracking API endpoint's authentication (write key) or explicit delivery-guarantee/retry semantics for event ingestion. Missing for 10: explicit HTTP ingestion endpoint docs with write-key auth, and documented delivery guarantees (retries, batching, at-least-once semantics) for server-to-server track calls.
